{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Check for sentinel values
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_final:", df['biomarker_final'].unique())

# Check for invalid changes (e.g., negative change in treatment arm)
print("\nSummary of biomarker change by arm:")
df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].describe()"}
